promptTemplate: Vintage risograph print illustration, slightly isometric view: [one object]. Halftone dot shading, misregistered ink, limited palette of deep teal, cream and tomato red with dark navy outlines, paper grain. A self-contained vignette isolated on a transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no people.
processing: Downloaded inside the Higgsfield sandbox, trimmed, 620px PNG masters, exported here as WebP q80 alpha90 at 240 and 480px with sharp. Reviewed at full size: no text, no flags, no people. The military master carried a translucent light haze around the tags (alpha 25–100); alpha below 100 was cleared and 100–160 ramped before export so it sits cleanly on dark tiles.
